verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state the agent 'takes action through your APIs and MCP servers' (docs-28), give concrete examples like refund workflows and order-status tool tests (docs-19, docs-24, docs-43), and describe workflow-scoped tool access, server-side identity validation, and hard execution caps enforced in code rather than prompts (docs-34). This directly matches the story of scoped, real-world API actions like refunds/order changes/subscriptions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the auth-scoping mechanism, and more granular detail on how 'per action' scopes are configured/enforced beyond high-level guardrails language.
